Class McpSecurityConfig

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpSecurityConfig
@Configuration @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class McpSecurityConfig extends Object
The security chain and the tool registration of the MCP server under /api/mcp. Everything here exists only with the deployment switch gt.use.mcp=true, which also switches the Spring AI starter on; whether the server answers at all is decided at run time by the administrator through the global parameter gt.mcp.use.

The chain matches only the MCP paths and is ordered before the main chain of SecurityGTConfig, which matches every request. Its only authentication filter is the access token filter, so a browser JWT authenticates nothing here, and the main chain never sees the access token filter, so a token is never accepted elsewhere. There is no read-only tenant filter: it decides by HTTP method, and every MCP call is a POST.
